Nothing to see here yet, except maybe a nice old tractor.

**Straightbourne** is a portmanteau of two family names. 

**Straight** is from the West Virginia Straight line that includes Jacob Straight, father of my grandfather's grandfather's grandfather, who was killed and scalped in Monongalia County, WV in October 1786 by Shawnee Indians. 

**Bourne** is from the London line of Bournes that included my great-grandfather George Alfred Bourne who walked with his barrow to help build Letchworth Garden City, the first of its design, separating industrial from residential spaces in order to improve the quality of life for its citizens. I grew up in Letchworth.
